messages:
Lina: Heads-up — Sienna Biotech dedicated cutover tentatively scheduled Thu Apr 2 22:00 UTC for tenancy si-bio-prod. Need infra + security + product go/no-go by EOD Thu.

Samir: Copy. Can we confirm model pinning, fallback policy, and instance class?

Lina: Pinning to rwinf-v2.1-quant (int8 profile). Node pool: p3d-4x. Canary 5% for 15m, then promote to 100% if metrics hold. Fallback: rwinf-v2.0-fp16.

Adele: From product: we want a 5% canary + 30m validation (latency + quality). Release notes here: https://redwood.internal/releases/si-bio-2026-04-02 (short changelog + prompt tests).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @Lina for 2026-04-02T22:00:00Z. Change window: 2h. Rollback conditions: error rate > 3% OR p95 latency regression > 30% vs baseline. Canary id will be generated at start.

Mark: SecOps note — KMS rotation must be done before go. Also require audit logging enabled for the tenant. If any data-plane schema changes occur we need a hard stop.

Samir: Infra checklist: autoscaler min=8 max=12, circuit-breaker enabled, KV cache warmup script ran. I'll paste the apply snippet we will use.

Samir:
```\nkubectl apply -f si-bio-dedicated-deploy-20260402.yaml\n# monitor\nkubectl rollout status deploy/sienna-service -w\n# rollback (if needed)\nkubectl rollout undo deployment/sienna-service --to-revision=58\n```\n
secops: Confirmed: KMS rotation completed (PR #452 merged), audit logs on and shipped to central bucket, retention 90d. Security APPROVE.

Adele: Product APPROVE if canary metrics green: p95 < 1200ms, gen quality pass >= 98% on golden prompt set. I'll run smoke prompts during canary.

Lina: Assigning go/no-go owners: Samir (infra), secops (security), Adele (product), Mark (customer success). Please reply here with your sign-off.

Samir: Infra go ✅ — autoscaler/pools set, will watch redis and KV cache. Abort & rollback on >2% 5xx sustained for 5m.

secops: Security go ✅ — audit logs + KMS verified.

Adele: Product go ✅ — smoke prompts queued and will run during canary.

Mark: CS go ✅ — customer comms template ready.

Lina: All green. I'll trigger the deploy bot at 22:00 UTC and follow the canary plan.

deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy — 5% traffic to rwinf-v2.1-quant (canary id c-20260402-01). Monitoring: latency, errors, token cost. Alerts to #eng-oncall and mobile pings to oncall.

Samir: Canary +12m: p95 860ms, errors 0.3%, KV hit rate 92% — looks stable.

Adele: QA: 120 validation prompts run, pass rate 99%. No regression in hallucination checks.

Lina: Proceeding to full rollout in 10m unless anyone objects.

Mark: No objections. Proceed.

deploy-bot: Rollout progressing to 100% — canary promoted. Version pinned: rwinf-v2.1-quant.

Samir: Post-rollout checks: autoscaler steady, no spike in infra errors.

secops: Post-rollout security check complete. Logs flowing and integrity checks OK.

Adele: Product smoke still green.

Lina: Rollout complete, no rollback needed. Closing thread — thanks everyone :tada:
